items.title: Within 1 year I went from making $11k a year being a YouTuber to over six figures doing private
items.summary:
Within 1 year I went from making $11k a year being a YouTuber to over six figures doing private astrology readings. 

‼️Your life can change fast in a year and I’m proof of that. 

But a lot of people don’t believe they have it in them to actually make the change they know they could. 

💥Success really comes down to two things…

1. enthusiasm. Nay! OBSESSION. 

2. Consistency 

Passion for your craft is contagious. 

Care and love for your work is magnetic. 

When you love what you do so much, the energy reflects it. 

Everyone can feel it. 

Your clients are so excited to book you again and again. 

Your waitlist fills up. 

Your astrology consultations get booked up for 3 months within 20 minutes. 

ENERGY IS POWERFUL. We all have it. 

Enthusiasm and passion is something people are AFRAID to share online. 

Most people are afraid of being seen. 

Most people are afraid of letting their heart and excitement and sparkle in their eye be visible by strangers on the internet. 

But when you realize that being seen and visible is actually the WAY to make more income, book your readings and have the financial and time freedom to live the life of your dreams and work from anywhere…..

Ugh it’s SO worth it all. 

It’s worth the fear of being seen. 

Consistency. 🎯 

The reason I have success is because I never quit. 

I’ve been sharing my life on the internet for 10 years (on my Instagram, on my blog, then YouTube) and no one watched me. 

Still never quit. 

Be so f***ing stubborn that life has no alternative than to give you what you want. 😮‍💨

I knew it would be worth it someday. So I never stopped posting. 

⭐️The people who win in the end have the stamina to never quit. That’s staying power. That’s legacy, that’s a CAREER, not a trending social media hobby. 

They know the vision, the result, the sacrifice, that’s so worth the hours of work and the many years of invisibility.

If you’re ready to be done with the excuses you’ve made for yourself... 

If you’re ready to finally commit and devote yourself to your craft and being the best astrologer (in both timing AND business)

items.title: Venus Retrograde 2026: DAGGERS & DELIGHTS!
items.summary:
What can 2nd Century astrologer Antiochus and the movie Legally Blonde teach us about Venus retrograde in Scorpio and Libra? 

Kepler College instructor Joey Cannizzaro interviews Skye Barclay about her new book tailor-made for this Venus retrograde: 2026 Venus Retrograde: A Dance of Daggers and Delights. An innovative workbook and transit guide, it offers a variety of different access points for readers to connect to the energy of this moment in a more embodied, playful, and intuitive way. Among other brilliant Venusian insights, Skye uses her own experience with braiding, maintaining, and re-braiding black hair as a model for Venus' phases of visibility and invisibility in relationship to the sun. Throughout their conversation, Skye and Joey take concepts and frameworks from ancient astrology and ground them in our contemporary moment, showing how ideas and techniques from 2000 years ago resonate with the stories we tell and the lives we live today.

items.title: October Astrology Forecast 2026
items.summary:
A detailed look at the astrology forecast for October 2026, with astrologer Chris Brennan. 

This month is dominated by a tumultuous Venus retrograde in Scorpio, kicking off alongside intense hard aspects to Mars and Pluto, which will dredge up some challenging things from the past.

Tensions are further heightened as Mercury slows down and stations retrograde in Scorpio later in the month, bringing communication breakdowns and the need for significant retooling.

I explore the historical precedents for these transits and break down how to navigate this tough astrological weather before the planets finally station direct and offer resolution in mid-November.

This is episode 551 of The Astrology Podcast.
